issues.description: get_user_by_name() builds a SQL query via raw string concatenation of user input, enabling SQL injection.
API_KEY is a hardcoded secret string defined as a module-level constant.
get_users_by_ids() issues one DB query per id inside a loop (N+1 query pattern) instead of a single batched query.
f(x, y) has a non-descriptive name, no docstring, and the file mixes camelCase (formatUserName) with snake_case (calculate_total) naming conventions.
Only calculate_total() is covered by tests; formatUserName() and f() in utils.py have zero test coverage.
